scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
source_title: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY Official Portal and Guidelines
target_beneficiaries: Poor, deprived rural families and identified occupational categories of urban workers; senior citizens aged 70+

eligibility_criteria.rural_criteria: Identified deprived households based on SECC 2011: (D1) Only one room with kucha walls/roof, (D2) No adult member aged 16-59, (D3) Female-headed household with no adult male member, (D4) Disabled member and no able-bodied adult, (D5) SC/ST households, (D7) Landless households deriving major income from manual casual labour
eligibility_criteria.urban_criteria: 11 defined occupational categories: Ragpicker, beggar, domestic worker, street vendor, cobbler/hawker, construction worker, plumber, mason, painter, transport worker, shop worker, waiter, mechanic
eligibility_criteria.senior_citizen_expansion: All senior citizens aged 70 years and above are eligible for distinct top-up cover of Rs. 5 lakh per year irrespective of socio-economic status
eligibility_criteria.family_cap: No cap on family size or age of members
exclusions: Households owning motorized 2/3/4 wheeler or mechanized agricultural equipment
Households having Kisan Credit Card with credit limit of Rs. 50,000 or above
Households with any member as a government employee
Households paying income tax or professional tax
Households owning a pucca house with more than 3 rooms

benefits.health_cover: Rs. 5,00,000 per family per year on a family floater basis for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization
benefits.coverage_details: Covers medical examination, consultation, treatment, pre and post-hospitalization expenses (up to 3 days pre and 15 days post), diagnostic and lab investigations, medicine costs, ICU and bed charges
benefits.cashless_nature: 100% cashless and paperless at all empaneled public and private hospitals across India

online_steps: Visit the NHA Beneficiary Portal https://beneficiary.nha.gov.in/ or download the Ayushman App
Log in with active mobile number using OTP authentication
Search beneficiary family using Aadhaar number, Ration Card number, or Family ID
If name appears, proceed with e-KYC using Aadhaar OTP, IRIS, or fingerprint
Capture live photograph and match demographic details
Download Ayushman Card (Golden Card) upon approval
application_process.offline_option: Visit any Empaneled Health Care Provider (EHCP) hospital and approach the 'Ayushman Mitra' desk, or visit a local Common Service Centre (CSC) with Ration Card and Aadhaar

required_documents: Aadhaar Card of the individual member
Ration Card or State-recognized Family Identification Document
Active mobile number linked with Aadhaar
Government Photo ID Proof (Voter ID, Driving License) if secondary verification required
